additional_thread_investigated.title: Statistical Arbitrage in Options Markets by Graph Learning and Synthetic Long Positions (Hong & Klabjan)
additional_thread_investigated.notes: Distinct paper from the already-covered H347 (arXiv:2510.11616, 'Attention Factors for Statistical Arbitrage' -- similar title, different arXiv ID, confirmed via grep of pairs-trading.md and hypothesis-log.md line 76). This paper (RNConv graph model + SLSA position construction) reports a modest average P&L information ratio of 0.1627 -- not a Sharpe, and not a strong number relative to this project's ~1.3-4.0 gate thresholds. Validated only on KOSPI 200 (Korean) index options, a market this project has no existing infrastructure for. Mechanistically targets options-market arbitrage rather than the equity-pairs-cointegration family H152-H200 already exhausted. Judged insufficiently actionable to stage: weak headline metric, foreign-market validation only, and would require building a graph-learning model plus options-chain data pipeline from scratch. Logged here for future reference rather than staged.
